svg.title: Neuropixels mismatch responses
svg.desc: Panel A summarizes mean mismatch-minus-control firing-rate effects across 48 frontal, visual, hippocampal, and thalamic areas for all events. Panel B shows representative unit heatmaps plus raw and baseline-subtracted population PSTHs for one event per context.
svg.text: Area-level mismatch response across all conditions
Mean response-window firing rate: mismatch minus matched control; areas with ≥10 pooled QC-passing units
Top 150 QC-passing units by absolute response effect; heatmap color is mismatch minus control spikes/s
